commit.message:
🚀 Pharaoh Control Panel 2.0 - Complete Communication Services Integration

✅ Database Connectivity & API Integration:
- Fixed Neon database configuration and connection
- Resolved port conflicts (changed from 5001 to 5002)
- Added comprehensive API endpoints for all communication services
- Implemented proper error handling and data validation

✅ Communication Services Implementation:
- Mailcow Email Service: Domain and account management
- WhatsApp 360Dialog API: Contact and message management
- Discord.js Bot Integration: Server and channel management
- All services initialized with proper database schemas

✅ Frontend-Backend Integration:
- Added Vite proxy configuration for API routing
- Implemented React Query for efficient data fetching
- Created comprehensive communication manager UI
- Fixed development vs production routing issues

✅ Production Deployment Ready:
- Updated Dockerfile and package.json for production builds
- Fixed server startup and routing configurations
- Added proper health checks and monitoring
- Configured static file serving for production

✅ Enterprise AI Features:
- Hyper-Contextual Root Cause Analysis
- Proactive Performance Anomaly Detection
- AI-Enhanced Security Monitoring
- Smart Resource Optimization
- Intelligent Documentation Generation

🎯 All databases connected to respective pages and API endpoints working correctly!
